Q1.purpose: Refund count and amount by reason for Notion Freelance OS in August vs September
Q1.sql:
SELECT date_format(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
       r.reason,
       COUNT(*) AS refund_count,
       SUM(r.amount_usd) AS refund_amount_usd
FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
JOIN WHYDROP_PG.refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.name = 'Notion Freelance OS'
  AND to_date(o.date) >= '2026-08-01' AND to_date(o.date) < '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY month, r.reason
ORDER BY month, refund_count DESC

Q2.purpose: Support ticket volume by category for Notion Freelance OS in August vs September
Q2.sql:
SELECT date_format(to_date(t.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
       t.category,
       COUNT(*) AS ticket_count
FROM WHYDROP_PG.support_tickets t
JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.orders o ON t.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.name = 'Notion Freelance OS'
  AND to_date(t.date) >= '2026-08-01' AND to_date(t.date) < '2026-10-01'
  AND t.category IN ('product defect','not as described','billing')
GROUP BY month, t.category
ORDER BY month, ticket_count DESC

Q3.purpose: Net revenue comparison (gross minus refunds) for Notion Freelance OS in August vs September
Q3.sql:
SELECT date_format(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
       SUM(o.unit_price_usd * o.quantity) AS gross_revenue_usd,
       SUM(r.amount_usd) AS refunds_usd,
       SUM(o.unit_price_usd * o.quantity) - SUM(r.amount_usd) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
LEFT JOIN WHYDROP_PG.refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE o.product_id = (SELECT product_id FROM WHYDROP_FILES.products WHERE name = 'Notion Freelance OS')
  AND to_date(o.date) >= '2026-08-01' AND to_date(o.date) < '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

Q5.purpose: Aggregate order metrics for Notion Freelance OS in August and September 2026
Q5.sql:
WITH notional_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id,
         o.date,
         o.product_id,
         o.unit_price_usd,
         o.quantity
  FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
  JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE p.name = 'Notion Freelance OS'
),
monthly_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count,
    SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity,
    AVG(CAST(unit_price_usd AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_unit_price,
    SUM(CAST(unit_price_usd AS DOUBLE) * CAST(quantity AS DOUBLE)) AS gross_revenue
  FROM notional_orders
  WHERE date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') IN ('2026-08', '2026-09')
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month,
       order_count,
       total_quantity,
       avg_unit_price,
       gross_revenue
FROM monthly_metrics
ORDER BY month

Q6.purpose: Calculate month‑over‑month percent changes to see if demand fell more than price rose
Q6.sql:
WITH monthly_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count,
    SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity,
    AVG(CAST(unit_price_usd AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_unit_price,
    SUM(CAST(unit_price_usd AS DOUBLE) * CAST(quantity AS DOUBLE)) AS gross_revenue
  FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
  JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE p.name = 'Notion Freelance OS'
    AND date_format(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') IN ('2026-08', '2026-09')
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT
  m1.month AS pre_month,
  m2.month AS post_month,
  (m2.order_count - m1.order_count) / m1.order_count * 100 AS order_count_pct_change,
  (m2.total_quantity - m1.total_quantity) / m1.total_quantity * 100 AS total_quantity_pct_change,
  (m2.avg_unit_price - m1.avg_unit_price) / m1.avg_unit_price * 100 AS avg_price_pct_change,
  (m2.gross_revenue - m1.gross_revenue) / m1.gross_revenue * 100 AS gross_revenue_pct_change
FROM monthly_metrics m1
JOIN monthly_metrics m2 ON m1.month = '2026-08' AND m2.month = '2026-09'

       total_clicks,
       total_sessions,
       total_landings,
       total_clicks / NULLIF(total_sessions,0) AS clicks_per_session,
       total_landings / NULLIF(total_sessions,0) AS landings_per_session

  WHERE to_date(m.date) >= '2026-08-01'
    AND to_date(m.date) < '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY month
  HAVING month IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
) t
ORDER BY month

       total_sessions,

       total_clicks,

  SELECT date_format(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,

  WHERE p.name = 'Notion Freelance OS'
    AND o.channel = 'paid_social'
    AND to_date(o.date) >= '2026-08-01'
    AND to_date(o.date) < '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY month
) t

Q14.sql: WITH monthly_revenue AS ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month, p.product_id, SUM(o.unit_price_usd * o.quantity) AS revenue_usd FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders o JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.name LIKE 'Notion Freelance OS%' AND DATE_FORMAT(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') IN ('2026-08','2026-09') GROUP BY month, p.product_id ), month_totals AS ( SELECT month, SUM(revenue_usd) AS total_revenue FROM monthly_revenue GROUP BY month ) SELECT mr.month, mr.product_id, mr.revenue_usd, ROUND(100.0 * mr.revenue_usd / mt.total_revenue, 2) AS revenue_share_pct FROM monthly_revenue mr JOIN month_totals mt ON mr.month = mt.month ORDER BY mr.month, mr.revenue_usd DESC LIMIT 40

Q15.purpose: Check if quantity shifted toward lower‑priced variants by comparing total quantity of orders for products priced below the new price versus those at or above the new price in September (post‑price‑hike) vs August (pre‑price‑hike)
Q15.sql: WITH price_change AS ( SELECT product_id, new_price_usd, MIN(date) AS change_date FROM WHYDROP_FILES.pricing_changes WHERE product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM WHYDROP_FILES.products WHERE name LIKE 'Notion Freelance OS%') GROUP BY product_id, new_price_usd ), orders_prepared AS ( SELECT o.order_id, o.product_id, o.date, o.unit_price_usd, o.quantity, DATE_FORMAT(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month, CASE WHEN o.unit_price_usd < pc.new_price_usd THEN 'low' ELSE 'high' END AS price_bucket, CASE WHEN o.date < pc.change_date THEN 'pre' ELSE 'post' END AS period FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders o JOIN price_change pc ON o.product_id = pc.product_id WHERE o.date >= '2026-08-01' AND o.date < '2026-10-01' ) SELECT period, month, SUM(CASE WHEN price_bucket = 'low' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS qty_low, SUM(CASE WHEN price_bucket = 'high' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS qty_high, SUM(CASE WHEN price_bucket = 'low' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN price_bucket = 'high' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS total_qty FROM orders_prepared GROUP BY period, month ORDER BY period, month

Q18.purpose: Count technical/download support tickets in August (pre‑release) and September (post‑release) for Notion Freelance OS.
Q18.sql:
WITH max_release_date AS (
  SELECT max(to_date(date)) AS max_date
  FROM WHYDROP_FILES.release_log rl
  JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.products p ON rl.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE p.name LIKE '%Notion%Freelance%OS%'
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') = '2026-08' THEN 'pre_release'
    WHEN date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') = '2026-09' THEN 'post_release'
  END AS period,
  COUNT(*) AS tickets_technical_download
FROM WHYDROP_PG.support_tickets

  AND to_date(date) >= (SELECT max_date FROM max_release_date)
  AND to_date(date) < date_add((SELECT max_date FROM max_release_date), 30)
  AND date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY period;

  END AS period,

Q21.purpose: Calculate month‑over‑month revenue and order change per country to see if the decline is concentrated.
Q21.sql:
SELECT
  o.country,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.date >= '2026-08-01' AND o.date < '2026-09-01' THEN CAST(o.unit_price_usd AS DOUBLE) * CAST(o.quantity AS INT) ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_aug,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.date >= '2026-09-01' AND o.date < '2026-10-01' THEN CAST(o.unit_price_usd AS DOUBLE) * CAST(o.quantity AS INT) ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_sep,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.date >= '2026-09-01' AND o.date < '2026-10-01' THEN CAST(o.unit_price_usd AS DOUBLE) * CAST(o.quantity AS INT) ELSE 0 END) -
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.date >= '2026-08-01' AND o.date < '2026-09-01' THEN CAST(o.unit_price_usd AS DOUBLE) * CAST(o.quantity AS INT) ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_diff,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN o.date >= '2026-08-01' AND o.date < '2026-09-01' THEN CAST(o.unit_price_usd AS DOUBLE) * CAST(o.quantity AS INT) ELSE 0 END) = 0
       THEN NULL
       ELSE ROUND(
            (SUM(CASE WHEN o.date >= '2026-09-01' AND o.date < '2026-10-01' THEN CAST(o.unit_price_usd AS DOUBLE) * CAST(o.quantity AS INT) ELSE 0 END) -
             SUM(CASE WHEN o.date >= '2026-08-01' AND o.date < '2026-09-01' THEN CAST(o.unit_price_usd AS DOUBLE) * CAST(o.quantity AS INT) ELSE 0 END)) /
            SUM(CASE WHEN o.date >= '2026-08-01' AND o.date < '2026-09-01' THEN CAST(o.unit_price_usd AS DOUBLE) * CAST(o.quantity AS INT) ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2)
  END AS revenue_change_pct,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN o.date >= '2026-08-01' AND o.date < '2026-09-01' THEN 1 END) AS orders_aug,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN o.date >= '2026-09-01' AND o.date < '2026-10-01' THEN 1 END) AS orders_sep
FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.products p
  ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.name = 'Notion Freelance OS'
GROUP BY o.country
ORDER BY revenue_change_pct DESC
LIMIT 40
